notes: אֶפֶס כִּי is read as a two-morpheme fusion on *Howbeit* under rule 30, the fixed expression being rendered by one English word; the split reading, giving *Howbeit* to אֶפֶס alone and marking כִּי unrepresented, is named in that unit's note.
*no* goes to לֹא under rule 15's recast-negation sentence, discontinuous from the verb, leaving אֶבְיוֹן the bare *poor*.
